_comment: Per-process definitions for the case-queue assistant. One engine, one entry per process. 'row_regex' parses the list row as it appears on screen (used for replay against the logs); in the browser the same fields come from the table cells. Decision rules are ordered; first match wins; 'human' means the assistant drafts but a person decides.

P6.name: 請求書照合・承認 (invoice matching & approval)
P6.row_regex: ^(?P<vendor_id>V\d+) (?P<vendor>.+?) 請求書承認 (?P<invoice_no>INV-\d{4}-\d+) (?P<amount>[\d,]+円) (?P<kind>定常|調整) (?P<status>\S+)$

decision.reason: 種別=調整 (adjustment invoice) — practised rule: agrees with all 25 logged decisions (replay.py)
種別=定常 (regular invoice) — practised rule: agrees with all 25 logged decisions (replay.py)

P6.note_template: 請求書照合完了。{invoice_no} 金額：{amount}。{decision_text}。

P1.name: 経費精算確認 (expense claim check)

decision.text: 規程内であることを確認した
decision.reason: policy limits per category not yet confirmed; every logged case was approved, so the rejection branch is unobserved

P1.note_template: 経費精算確認済み。費目：{category} 金額：{amount}。{decision_text}。

P2.name: 勤怠・休暇申請確認 (leave request approval)

decision.reason: entitlement balance not visible in the list

P8.name: 予算差異分析 (budget variance analysis)
P8.row_regex: ^(?P<dept_id>D\d+) (?P<dept>\S+) 予算差異分析 (?P<month>\d{4}-\d{2}) (?P<detail>予算 [\d,]+ / 実績 [\d,]+ \(差異 [+\-][\d.]+%\)) (?P<status>\S+)$

screen.system: 受発注在庫管理システム

P13.row_regex: ^(?P<emp_id>E\d+) (?P<name>\S+ \S+) (?P<req_type>\S+) (?P<month>\d{4}-\d{2}) 申請者：(?P<dept>\S+) 優先度：(?P<priority>\S+) 承認者：(?P<approver>\S+) (?P<status>\S+)$
